translations.en.sahih: I swear by the Day of Resurrection
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection;
translations.en.yusufali: I do call to witness the Resurrection Day;
translations.id.indonesian: Aku bersumpah demi hari kiamat,

transliteration: Wa laaa uqsimu bin nafsil lawwaamah

translations.en.sahih: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, I swear by the accusing soul (that this Scripture is true).
translations.en.yusufali: And I do call to witness the self-reproaching spirit: (Eschew Evil).
translations.id.indonesian: dan aku bersumpah dengan jiwa yang amat menyesali (dirinya sendiri).

translations.en.sahih: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?
translations.en.pickthall: Thinketh man that We shall not assemble his bones?
translations.en.yusufali: Does man think that We cannot assemble his bones?
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah manusia mengira, bahwa Kami tidak akan mengumpulkan (kembali) tulang belulangnya?

arabic: بَلَىٰ قَـٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ

translations.en.sahih: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.
translations.en.pickthall: Yea, verily. We are Able to restore his very fingers!
translations.en.yusufali: Nay, We are able to put together in perfect order the very tips of his fingers.
translations.id.indonesian: Bukan demikian, sebenarnya Kami kuasa menyusun (kembali) jari jemarinya dengan sempurna.

translations.en.sahih: But man desires to continue in sin.
translations.en.pickthall: But man would fain deny what is before him.
translations.en.yusufali: But man wishes to do wrong (even) in the time in front of him.
translations.id.indonesian: Bahkan manusia itu hendak membuat maksiat terus menerus.

translations.en.sahih: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
translations.en.pickthall: He asketh: When will be this Day of Resurrection?
translations.en.yusufali: He questions: "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
translations.id.indonesian: Ia berkata: "Bilakah hari kiamat itu?"

translations.en.sahih: So when vision is dazzled
translations.en.pickthall: But when sight is confounded
translations.en.yusufali: At length, when the sight is dazed,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apabila mata terbelalak (ketakutan),

translations.en.sahih: And the moon darkens
translations.en.pickthall: And the moon is eclipsed
translations.en.yusufali: And the moon is buried in darkness.
translations.id.indonesian: dan apabila bulan telah hilang cahayanya,

translations.en.sahih: And the sun and the moon are joined,
translations.en.pickthall: And sun and moon are united,
translations.en.yusufali: And the sun and moon are joined together,-
translations.id.indonesian: dan matahari dan bulan dikumpulkan,

transliteration: Yaqoolul insaanu yaw ma 'izin aynal mafarr

translations.en.sahih: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"
translations.en.pickthall: On that day man will cry: Whither to flee!
translations.en.yusufali: That Day will Man say: "Where is the refuge?"
translations.id.indonesian: pada hari itu manusia berkata: "Ke mana tempat berlari?"

translations.en.sahih: No! There is no refuge.
translations.en.pickthall: Alas! No refuge!
translations.en.yusufali: By no means! No place of safety!
translations.id.indonesian: sekali-kali tidak! Tidak ada tempat berlindung!

translations.en.sahih: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.
translations.en.pickthall: Unto thy Lord is the recourse that day.
translations.en.yusufali: Before thy Lord (alone), that Day will be the place of rest.
translations.id.indonesian: Hanya kepada Tuhanmu sajalah pada hari itu tempat kembali.

arabic: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
transliteration: Yunabba 'ul insaanu yawma 'izim bimaa qaddama wa akhkhar

translations.en.sahih: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.
translations.en.pickthall: On that day man is told the tale of that which he hath sent before and left behind.
translations.en.yusufali: That Day will Man be told (all) that he put forward, and all that he put back.
translations.id.indonesian: Pada hari itu diberitakan kepada manusia apa yang telah dikerjakannya dan apa yang dilalaikannya.

translations.en.sahih: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,
translations.en.pickthall: Oh, but man is a telling witness against himself,
translations.en.yusufali: Nay, man will be evidence against himself,
translations.id.indonesian: Bahkan manusia itu menjadi saksi atas dirinya sendiri,

translations.en.sahih: Even if he presents his excuses.
translations.en.pickthall: Although he tender his excuses.
translations.en.yusufali: Even though he were to put up his excuses.
translations.id.indonesian: meskipun dia mengemukakan alasan-alasannya.

arabic: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
transliteration: Laa tuharrik bihee lisaa naka lita'jala bih

translations.en.sahih: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an.
translations.en.pickthall: Stir not thy tongue herewith to hasten it.
translations.en.yusufali: Move not thy tongue concerning the (Qur'an) to make haste therewith.
translations.id.indonesian: Janganlah kamu gerakkan lidahmu untuk (membaca) Al Quran karena hendak cepat-cepat (menguasai)nya.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! upon Us (resteth) the putting together thereof and the reading thereof.
translations.en.yusufali: It is for Us to collect it and to promulgate it:
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya atas tanggungan Kamilah mengumpulkannya (di dadamu) dan (membuatmu pandai) membacanya.

transliteration: Fa izaa qaraanaahu fattabi' qur aanah

translations.en.sahih: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.
translations.en.pickthall: And when We read it, follow thou the reading;
translations.en.yusufali: But when We have promulgated it, follow thou its recital (as promulgated):
translations.id.indonesian: Apabila Kami telah selesai membacakannya maka ikutilah bacaannya itu.

translations.en.sahih: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].
translations.en.pickthall: Then lo! upon Us (resteth) the explanation thereof.
translations.en.yusufali: Nay more, it is for Us to explain it (and make it clear):
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian, sesungguhnya atas tanggungan Kamilah penjelasannya.

translations.en.sahih: No! But you love the immediate
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but ye do love the fleeting Now
translations.en.yusufali: Nay, (ye men!) but ye love the fleeting life,
translations.id.indonesian: Sekali-kali janganlah demikian. Sebenarnya kamu (hai manusia) mencintai kehidupan dunia,

translations.en.sahih: And leave the Hereafter.
translations.en.pickthall: And neglect the Hereafter.
translations.en.yusufali: And leave alone the Hereafter.
translations.id.indonesian: dan meninggalkan (kehidupan) akhirat.

translations.en.sahih: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,
translations.en.pickthall: That day will faces be resplendent,
translations.en.yusufali: Some faces, that Day, will beam (in brightness and beauty);-
translations.id.indonesian: Wajah-wajah (orang-orang mukmin) pada hari itu berseri-seri.

translations.en.sahih: Looking at their Lord.
translations.en.pickthall: Looking toward their Lord;
translations.en.yusufali: Looking towards their Lord;
translations.id.indonesian: Kepada Tuhannyalah mereka melihat.

translations.en.sahih: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,
translations.en.pickthall: And that day will other faces be despondent,
translations.en.yusufali: And some faces, that Day, will be sad and dismal,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan wajah-wajah (orang kafir) pada hari itu muram,

translations.en.sahih: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.
translations.en.pickthall: Thou wilt know that some great disaster is about to fall on them.
translations.en.yusufali: In the thought that some back-breaking calamity was about to be inflicted on them;
translations.id.indonesian: mereka yakin bahwa akan ditimpakan kepadanya malapetaka yang amat dahsyat.

translations.en.sahih: No! When the soul has reached the collar bones
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but when the life cometh up to the throat
translations.en.yusufali: Yea, when (the soul) reaches to the collar-bone (in its exit),
translations.id.indonesian: Sekali-kali jangan. Apabila nafas (seseorang) telah (mendesak) sampai ke kerongkongan,

translations.en.sahih: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"
translations.en.pickthall: And men say: Where is the wizard (who can save him now)?
translations.en.yusufali: And there will be a cry, "Who is a magician (to restore him)?"
translations.id.indonesian: dan dikatakan (kepadanya): "Siapakah yang dapat menyembuhkan?",

translations.en.sahih: And the dying one is certain that it is the [time of] separation
translations.en.pickthall: And he knoweth that it is the parting;
translations.en.yusufali: And he will conclude that it was (the Time) of Parting;
translations.id.indonesian: dan dia yakin bahwa sesungguhnya itulah waktu perpisahan (dengan dunia),

translations.en.sahih: And the leg is wound about the leg,
translations.en.pickthall: And agony is heaped on agony;
translations.en.yusufali: And one leg will be joined with another:
translations.id.indonesian: dan bertaut betis (kiri) dan betis (kanan),

translations.en.sahih: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.
translations.en.pickthall: Unto thy Lord that day will be the driving.
translations.en.yusufali: That Day the Drive will be (all) to thy Lord!
translations.id.indonesian: kepada Tuhanmulah pada hari itu kamu dihalau.

translations.en.sahih: And the disbeliever had not believed, nor had he prayed.
translations.en.pickthall: For he neither trusted, nor prayed.
translations.en.yusufali: So he gave nothing in charity, nor did he pray!-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan ia tidak mau membenarkan (Rasul dan Al Quran) dan tidak mau mengerjakan shalat,

translations.en.sahih: But [instead], he denied and turned away.
translations.en.pickthall: But he denied and flouted.
translations.en.yusufali: But on the contrary, he rejected Truth and turned away!
translations.id.indonesian: tetapi ia mendustakan (Rasul) dam berpaling (dari kebenaran),

translations.en.sahih: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].
translations.en.pickthall: Then went he to his folk with glee.
translations.en.yusufali: Then did he stalk to his family in full conceit!
translations.id.indonesian: kemudian ia pergi kepada ahlinya dengan berlagak (sombong).

translations.en.sahih: Woe to you, and woe!
translations.en.pickthall: Nearer unto thee and nearer,
translations.en.yusufali: Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!
translations.id.indonesian: Kecelakaanlah bagimu (hai orang kafir) dan kecelakaanlah bagimu,

translations.en.sahih: Then woe to you, and woe!
translations.en.pickthall: Again nearer unto thee and nearer (is the doom).
translations.en.yusufali: Again, Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!
translations.id.indonesian: kemudian kecelakaanlah bagimu (hai orang kafir) dan kecelakaanlah bagimu.

translations.en.sahih: Does man think that he will be left neglected?
translations.en.pickthall: Thinketh man that he is to be left aimless?
translations.en.yusufali: Does man think that he will be left uncontrolled, (without purpose)?
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah manusia mengira, bahwa ia akan dibiarkan begitu saja (tanpa pertanggung jawaban)?

arabic: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
transliteration: Alam yaku nutfatam mim maniyyiny yumnaa

translations.en.sahih: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?
translations.en.pickthall: Was he not a drop of fluid which gushed forth?
translations.en.yusufali: Was he not a drop of sperm emitted (in lowly form)?
translations.id.indonesian: Bukankah dia dahulu setetes mani yang ditumpahkan (ke dalam rahim),

translations.en.sahih: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allah] created [his form] and proportioned [him]
translations.en.pickthall: Then he became a clot; then (Allah) shaped and fashioned
translations.en.yusufali: Then did he become a leech-like clot; then did (Allah) make and fashion (him) in due proportion.
translations.id.indonesian: kemudian mani itu menjadi segumpal darah, lalu Allah menciptakannya, dan menyempurnakannya,

transliteration: Faja'ala minhuz zawjayniz zakara wal unsaa

translations.en.sahih: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.
translations.en.pickthall: And made of him a pair, the male and female.
translations.en.yusufali: And of him He made two sexes, male and female.
translations.id.indonesian: lalu Allah menjadikan daripadanya sepasang: laki-laki dan perempuan.

arabic: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
transliteration: Alaisa zaalika biqaadirin 'alaaa any yuhyiyal mawtaa

translations.en.sahih: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?
translations.en.pickthall: Is not He (Who doeth so) Able to bring the dead to life?
translations.en.yusufali: Has not He, (the same), the power to give life to the dead?
translations.id.indonesian: Bukankah (Allah yang berbuat) demikian berkuasa (pula) menghidupkan orang mati?
